review_notes: All17 source declarations preserve signature, local assumptions, simp attributes and proof bytes. The module is unmatched in the inspected local upstream history; this does not assign authorship or theorem priority.
Finite truncation algebra/norm bounds, differentiation and infinite tail estimates are separated with explicit same-version imports. Internal proof steps remain within their original lemmas.
The tail and infinite series statements retain ‖z‖ < 1. The sharper factor2 estimate retains the additional ‖z‖ ≤ 1/2; neither condition is dropped.
The denominator helper keeps both 0 ≤ r and r ≤ 1/2. The finite polynomial norm bound is global and keeps its factor (m : ℝ) * max 1 (‖z‖ ^ m).
The comments motivate Weierstrass products, but this file proves no new existence of canonical products, Hadamard factorization or global logarithm branch.
